limitations: Pi5 aarch64 host CPU timing only: no ESP32, PSRAM, UART, VDP command service, scanout or full-game frame-rate claim.

make_affine/rebuilt_affine_host_model use a diagonal analytic inverse and an exact separately identified ESP-DSP 1.8.0 ANSI multiply; neither measures the old firmware Mat inverse, target-selected optimized DSP, allocations or cold matrix command cost.

Transform-to-buffer methods include host vector allocation, initialization and destruction; surrounding stock command40 buffer-service allocation/lookup/registration is absent. The kernel label does not mean allocation-free.

natural_buffer_size is prepared outside timing: transform_bitmap_kernel/transform_then_plot omit command40 natural bounds computation, matrix cache checks and command parser overhead. Full direct affine retains draw-time transformed bounds/clipping dispatch.
ordinary_pretransformed prepares stock command40 output once outside timing; it illustrates reuse after preparation and is not an adoption or new scaled-asset file path.
ordinary_original_size draws a different unscaled footprint; it is a control, not an equal-work scaling comparison.

All timed draws reuse the same source, transform, destination and framebuffer in Set mode, with one clear outside each timed batch. This is a warm repeated-draw test without scene motion, background repaint, queue contention, VSync or realistic framebuffer working-set churn.
Source alpha 0/3 and synthetic all-opaque/all-transparent are covered; partial alpha 1/2, blend modes, sprites and other source pixel formats are outside this fixture.

Direct affine clipping excludes its drawingRect X2/Y2 while natural command40 fills all resized pixels. The three observed footprint differences are retained, not treated as correctness failures or equal-pixel comparisons.

The observed player uses ordinary/no-transform plotting in all 900 replay frames. Affine/identity and mirror player cases deliberately probe alternate stock paths and do not imply those affine costs occur in the current player hot loop.

Fourteen selected workload/coverage cases plus two alpha controls are timed, not every observed artwork/matrix combination. Case order is fixed and method order reverses on alternate trials; there is no process affinity or fixed-frequency enforcement.
The 40 ms setting is a calibration target. Capped empty controls measure about 35 ms and later samples can vary slightly from calibration. No empty baseline is subtracted.
Only before/after host temperature, governor, frequency and load are recorded. These bound observed endpoints, not continuous peak temperature, scheduling load or frequency.

Run records final source hashes rather than an automatic before/after source-immutability check; separate agreed source freeze and this audit match every final pin. Original runtime snapshots are not byte-rebuilt firmware proofs.
Sanitizers cover the 16 selected cases and checksum checks; they do not prove the correctness of all affine matrices or make target hardware performance claims.
